assessments.support: FIQ and mean-FD-based inclusion thresholds (within 2 SD of ABIDE-wide mean) explicitly stated; resulting N (209 ASD, 298 controls) across 14 sites reported.
Demographic/clinical table given (age, FIQ, mean FD, high-motion timepoints, ADI-R and ADOS subscale scores) with site x group interaction statistics.
SPM8/DPARSF preprocessing pipeline with nuisance regression (WM/CSF signals, 24 motion parameters) and AAL-based time series extraction fully specified.
ADI-R and ADOS subscale scores reported for the ASD group in the demographic table.
Age, FIQ, mean FD and site x group interaction effects all explicitly tested and reported (male-only sample removes sex as a confound).
A data-driven subject-selection algorithm maximised p-values of group differences in age/FIQ/FD and of site x group interactions; results reported both with and without regressing out site and FIQ.
HMM-derived dynamic brain-state metrics (fractional occupancy, lifetimes, interval times, transition probabilities) are described in methodological detail.
Two-tailed two-sample t-tests with Bonferroni correction across the 19 HMM states.

risk_of_bias.summary: A well-controlled associational ABIDE study with explicit motion/FIQ-based inclusion thresholds, site x group interaction checks, a named pipeline/atlas, and multiple-comparison-corrected statistics.

charting.title: Reconfiguration of Brain Network Dynamics in Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on Hidden Markov Model
charting.authors: Lin P; Zang S; Bai Y; Wang H
charting.severity_levels: ADI-R Social/Communication/RRB and ADOS Total scores reported
charting.age_matched: Yes (p=0.7191 reported, no significant group difference)
charting.dataset_openly_available: Publicly available ABIDE dataset cited (http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/); no study-specific code repository mentioned
charting.specific_features: Hidden Markov Model (HMM) brain states (19 states) over AAL-atlas regional time series; fractional occupancy, lifetime, interval time, and state-transition probabilities
charting.summary_key_findings: Using a Hidden Markov Model over resting-state fMRI from 507 ABIDE participants (209 ASD, 298 matched controls, 14 sites), ASD subjects showed significantly decreased fractional occupancy in HMM states 4, 8, 9 and 10 and significantly increased fractional occupancy in states 2, 3, 14 and 17 compared to controls (Bonferroni-corrected two-sample t-tests), with the ASD-related module characterised by altered community structure of brain-state transitions.
charting.features_associated_disorder: HMM brain states 4, 8, 9, 10 (decreased fractional occupancy in ASD) and states 2, 3, 14, 17 (increased fractional occupancy in ASD)
charting.feature_change_direction: Mixed: decreased occupancy in states 4/8/9/10, increased occupancy in states 2/3/14/17 for ASD vs. controls
charting.future_directions_recommended: Brain dynamics should remain a prime target for further ASD research, especially regarding intrinsic states underlying brain activity

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Group-difference (associational); ABIDE I; 507 male subjects (209 ASD, 298 controls) from 14 sites, FIQ- and motion-matched
narrative_row.methods: SPM8/DPARSF preprocessing with AAL-atlas time series; Hidden Markov Model identifying 19 recurring whole-brain states; fractional occupancy, lifetime, interval-time and transition-probability statistics compared between groups with Bonferroni-corrected two-sample t-tests, with and without regressing out site and FIQ
narrative_row.outcomes: ASD subjects showed significantly decreased fractional occupancy in HMM states 4, 8, 9, 10 and increased occupancy in states 2, 3, 14, 17 relative to controls; transition-map community structure differed between ASD-related and HC-related modules
narrative_row.key_limitations: Male-only sample limits generalisability; site effects addressed via subject matching and covariate regression rather than formal harmonisation (e.g. ComBat)
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A dynamic (HMM-based) rather than static connectivity analysis of a well-documented, site-matched ABIDE I subset, with explicit motion/FIQ inclusion thresholds and site-interaction checks
